notes: No PathNode / cover / NavigationCell / TnTactical* objects exist in any Streets package: the map has no AI tactical data (WFC MP has no bots on Streets). Other MP maps (e.g. MP_ESC_BrokenHope) do carry TnTactical data.

The graph is UE3's editor-built path network over the gameplay NavigationPoints. reachFlags names are the stock UE3 ReachSpec enum (HIGH CONFIDENCE for this licensee build); TnReachSpec default ForcedPathSizeName = "Vehicle".
Objective points (flag capture, bomb plant, domination, KOTH) own no ReachSpecs; they only receive one-way edges (destination-only), which accounts for the 10 one-way pairs.

Every edge is <= 3385 UU, just under the nav points' authored MaxConnectionDistance 3400: with no intermediate PathNodes the editor only linked gameplay nav points within ~34 m, so the network is fragmented into islands. It is NOT a usable whole-map AI navigation graph; any bot/AI navigation for Streets must be generated, not recovered.

Path sizes (Radius/Height UU) seen on nodes/edges: 250/300, 440/400, 750/800, 1210/850. The size-class table (WFC scout PathSizes) is editor-only and not in the cook: the stock Engine.Default__Scout table (Human 48/80 ... Vehicle 260/120) does not match, so size names are UNKNOWN.
